_note: Synthetic day-anchored corpus for the temporal-deixis eval. 'ref_date' is the pinned 'now' (a Saturday); every deictic query in goldset.json resolves against it. Each memory carries an explicit daily_ref so memorize() links it to a known Day node. 'role' documents intent and is ignored by seed.py: target = the on-day memory a deictic query should surface; decoy = an off-day memory phrased to be the STRONGER topical match, which scope must beat; filler = same-day context; noise = unrelated. All data is fictional.
